verdict.rationale: Rive documents an in-editor AI agent and MCP tooling, but they generate content: scripts, layouts, data models, state machines and animation. Nothing in the evidence shows the product analyzing a user's data or files to surface insights or suggestions. That makes the agent an adjacent generative feature rather than the insights capability this story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
